material_regression_explanation: Instruction/branch microbenchmarks include the new explicit lifecycle, capability and execution-budget checks on every step. This is an intentional isolation/mediation cost for 4.1.0; arithmetic and load/store kernels remain substantially closer. Performance optimization is not used to waive any correctness gate and is carried as a measured non-blocking optimization item.

size.comparison_note: Not like-for-like: 4.1.0 production boundary intentionally counts src + all adapters + spec + Makefile and excludes host CLI/tooling.
